# Checkbox

You might say
These options don't conflict, so people should be able to choose more than one.

**Choose one, several, or none of the options**·Checkboxes work for interests, filters, and other choices that are independent of one another. A single checkbox can also confirm one statement. If exactly one option must be selected, use [Radio](/vibe-hub/radio?lang=en) instead.

## You can say this to an AI Agent

> Use three independent checkboxes for email, SMS, and app notifications, allowing several or none, and apply them on submit. Verify clickable labels and the submitted channel values.
